Card.anatomy: container with optional header, content, footer
Card.responsiveBehavior: full-width en mobile, max-width 480 en desktop

Button.anatomy: label + optional icon (left or right) + loading spinner
Button.responsiveBehavior: full-width en mobile, fit-content en desktop

Input.anatomy: label + input + helper text + error message
Input.interactions: ring on focus, shake animation on error

Table.anatomy: header row + sortable cols + body rows + pagination footer
Table.interactions: click header to sort, row hover highlights
Table.responsiveBehavior: horizontal scroll en mobile; sticky header

Modal.anatomy: overlay backdrop + centered panel with header, body, footer
Modal.interactions: fade backdrop + scale panel; ESC + click-outside cierran
Modal.responsiveBehavior: full-screen sheet en mobile, centered en desktop

Header.anatomy: logo + nav links + user menu + theme toggle

Sidebar.anatomy: logo + nav groups + active indicator + collapse toggle
Sidebar.responsiveBehavior: drawer en mobile, fixed en desktop

Footer.responsiveBehavior: stacked en mobile, 3-col grid en desktop

EmptyState.interactions: CTA opens flow para crear primer registro

ErrorState.interactions: click retry → loading; error_count tracked en analytics

Avatar.anatomy: circular image OR initials fallback + optional status dot
Avatar.responsiveBehavior: size prop respected; no responsive scale

Badge.anatomy: small pill with label + optional icon

Toast.anatomy: icon + message + optional action button + close
Toast.responsiveBehavior: stacked en bottom-right desktop, top-center mobile

Form.anatomy: vertical stack of FormFields + submit button + error banner
Form.interactions: validate onBlur, submit button disabled hasta valid

ClassCard.anatomy: image + title + teacher avatar + level badge + datetime + capacity
ClassCard.responsiveBehavior: stacked en mobile; horizontal en desktop

FilterBar.anatomy: search input + select dropdowns + clear-all button
FilterBar.interactions: filter changes update URL params; debounced search
FilterBar.responsiveBehavior: scroll horizontal en mobile; inline desktop

MembershipCard.anatomy: tier label + créditos progress bar + valid-until date + CTA renovar

BookingItem.anatomy: class title + datetime + status badge + actions (cancel)
BookingItem.interactions: click cancelar → ConfirmDialog si dentro de ventana
BookingItem.responsiveBehavior: stacked en mobile, horizontal en desktop
